platform: Custom (behind Imperva/Incapsula WAF); secondary official Caseta site casetawireless.com is Drupal
est_products: Unknown from official site (blocked). Distributor lightingsupply.com lists 2696 Lutron products/SKUs in /collections/lutron.
sku_format_match: yes - distributor variant.sku values are exact Lutron model numbers (e.g. CW-4-LA, MS-A102-V-TP, PD-REP-WH); 9 of 12 sample SKUs matched exactly

alternatives.name: LightingSupply.com
alternatives.notes: Reachable, no anti-bot seen. Handles follow 'lutron-<sku lowercased>'. Also matched AY-103PH-WH, PJL-2B-GWH-L01, MS-PPS6-DDV-HT, SFSQ-LF-GR, SCRS-20-TR-CY. Caveats: some images appear Amazon-sourced (filenames like 81DdnkOhrmL._AC_SY679_), and PD-REP-WH's first image is a different product's (Ecom_PD-15OUT-BL) - prefer images whose filename contains the SKU, else skip position 1 if it names another SKU. 1 of 2696 products had no image.

alternatives.name: Caseta Wireless (official Lutron Caseta site)
alternatives.notes: Reachable (200). Covers only Caseta line; product pages mention family model codes (e.g. PJ2-P2B-GWH) and color-swatch images under /sites/caseta/files/, not one image per SKU. Not suitable as bulk source.

alternatives.name: Home Depot
alternatives.notes: Search page returned 200 but query PD-REP-WH returned only related Caseta products (no exact match). Consumer assortment only; not recommended for bulk.

recommended_strategy: Harvest https://www.lightingsupply.com/collections/lutron/products.json?limit=250&page=1..11 (Shopify), build map variant.sku (uppercased) -> product.images[].src; match Lumera SKUs exactly after uppercasing/trim. For misses, try /search/suggest.json?q=<SKU>. Prefer image whose filename contains the SKU; drop images whose filename names a different SKU. Expect ~55-75% coverage; Lutron.com itself is not harvestable from here.
blockers: lutron.com (incl. robots.txt and sitemap.xml) returns 403 Imperva/Incapsula challenge to all requests; shop.lutron.com / store.lutron.com do not resolve via proxy (502); assets.lutron.com is a bare Azure App Service placeholder.
